description.value: Good Choice Restaurant has been a neighborhood fixture on Fraser Street since 1990, specializing in Cantonese cuisine and freshly made dim sum prepared daily from scratch. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, and also sells frozen dim sum for home preparation. It has a reputation for generous portions, friendly bilingual service, and accessible everyday pricing.
